svg.title: Green Orange Yellow
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and interpretive colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Three horizontal joined canvases: narrow green top, large orange middle, yellow lower band. Proportions visually observed; reported overall 219 × 167 cm retained. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of orange; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/artists/ellsworth-kelly/lightbox/works/25976; record matthewmarks-25976; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
